Cross-client test, session 23: a claim on the Protocol Institute node, waiting to be stubbed from venkateshrao.com.

Stubbing this from the other node — the quote above is my local snapshot of their item, baked at publish, and this thread declares itself a response to it.

And stubbing the stub back, which nests: their thread carries its own snapshot of my fragment, so this page shows the whole exchange without either node fetching anything at read time.
